why.en: FTP commands travel on TCP port 21. This only opens a TCP connection to a public test server and does not log in.
why.hinglish: FTP commands TCP port 21 par jaate hain. Ye sirf public test server se TCP connection kholta hai, login nahi karta.

expect.en: TcpTestSucceeded : True (or 'succeeded'). It varies by network; some block outgoing FTP.
expect.hinglish: TcpTestSucceeded : True (ya 'succeeded'). Network par depend karta hai; kuch outgoing FTP block karte hain.

title.en: Peek at an anonymous FTP listing over HTTP-style tools
title.hinglish: Anonymous FTP listing ek tool se dekho

why.en: curl speaks FTP too. This lists a public demo server with its published read-only demo login and shows the 220/331/230 replies with -v.
why.hinglish: curl FTP bhi bolta hai. Ye public demo server ki listing uske published read-only demo login se karta hai aur -v ke saath 220/331/230 replies dikhata hai.

expect.en: Lines starting with '<' show server replies such as 220 greeting, 331 password required, 230 logged in, 227/229 passive mode, then a file listing. The USER and PASS lines are sent in plain text. Exact text varies by server.
expect.hinglish: '<' se shuru hone wali lines 220 greeting, 331 password required, 230 logged in, 227/229 passive mode jaise server replies dikhati hain, phir file listing. USER aur PASS lines plain text mein jaati hain. Exact text server ke hisaab se badalta hai.

title.en: Find the clear-text login in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark to see USER and PASS in plain text on port 21.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur port 21 par USER aur PASS plain text mein dekho.

expect.en: The USER and PASS packets with the password readable in the packet details.
expect.hinglish: USER aur PASS packets jinke packet details mein password padha ja sakta hai.

why.en: The 227 reply holds the data port. Filter the data connection to port 50069 to see the file bytes.
why.hinglish: 227 reply mein data port hota hai. File bytes dekhne ke liye data connection ko port 50069 par filter karo.

expect.en: The 227 reply with (203,0,113,40,195,149), then a separate TCP connection to port 50069 carrying 2 segments of 1460 bytes.
expect.hinglish: (203,0,113,40,195,149) wala 227 reply, phir port 50069 par alag TCP connection jo 1460 bytes ke 2 segments carry karta hai.
